paper_level_summary_zh: 该论文在相关工作部分简要提及RFID可用于窃听，并将目标论文作为RFID窃听技术的一个例子列出，但没有进一步详细描述或评价其能力。

evidences.evidence_quote: Additionally, [22], [23] transforms the lidar sensing radar on a robotic vacuum cleaner into a laser microphone, and RFID[30] is also utilized for eavesdropping.
evidences.evidence_context: It is worth noting that the aforementioned eavesdropping attacks are considered invasive attacks, requiring the eavesdropper to either physically tamper with the victim's device or install malware on it. ... Non-intrusive eavesdropping attacks are continually being developed. For instance,[8],[9] employ WiFi Received Signal Strength (RSS) and Channel State Information (CSI) analysis, respectively, to identify specific words. ... Moreover, mmWave-based eavesdropping attacks have been explored. ... Optical eavesdropping is the most relevant eavesdropping technique to this article. ... Additionally,[22],[23] transforms the lidar sensing radar on a robotic vacuum cleaner into a laser microphone, and RFID[30] is also utilized for eavesdropping.

evidences.why_this_judgment_zh: 证据中仅提到RFID[30]被用于窃听，但[30]在正文中与其他引用[22][23]并列在一个列表句中，没有描述目标论文的具体能力（如亚毫米级、穿墙等），属于普通相关文献列举。该引用未提供任何细节支撑亚毫米级或穿墙窃听能力，因此应排除。
